text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-\n1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC.\n2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The note specifies the hardness range but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment applies (e.g., before or after final machining).
